caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on a beige background. At the center is a detailed depiction of a rounded pitcher or jug with three ornate feet and a single, elegantly curved handle. The pitcher has a wide, open mouth with a slightly outward-flared rim, and its body is bulbous, tapering to a narrower neck just below the rim. The handle features decorative curves and attaches from the rim down to the shoulder of the vessel. There are two rectangular insets: one at the top left, featuring the simple profiles of two chess-pawn-like objects, and one at the bottom right, showing a schematic line drawing of the pitcher with dimensions and annotations written around it. The entire main composition, including the pitcher and insets, is enclosed in a larger rectangular frame, and beneath this frame on the left, the name "Charles Cullen" is written in cursive.
title: Pewter Creamer
